name: Cadence
description: A cadence mark: wide, even bands, with the pattern turned a quarter in some cells.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); background-image: linear-gradient(@pick(0deg, 90deg), @stripe(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)) 30%, #0000, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)), #0000 90%)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
